title: 阅读中的后置修饰
goal: 识别句子主干，并确定后置修饰语的对象。

points.label: 找出含后置修饰的句子主干
确定从句和短语修饰的对象

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 后置修饰语放在所修饰的名词后面，可以是介词短语、定语从句或分词短语。读句子时先找主语和谓语，再看宾语和修饰关系。

body.box:
The book on the table belongs to Mei.
主干：The book belongs to Mei.
on the table 修饰 book。

body.p: 主干是句子的主谓关系。修饰语说明指的是哪一个，或补充信息。理解全句时修饰语不能丢掉。

cards.title: 介词短语
rows: The picture on the wall shows a quiet street, and the visitors discuss its colors during their tour of the room.
主干：The picture shows a quiet street；on the wall 修饰 picture。
The students in the back row asked several questions after the lecture, while the other students wrote notes at their desks.
主干：The students asked several questions；in the back row 修饰 students。
The basket under the table holds clean towels for the guests, who can take them to the small pool beside the garden.
主干：The basket holds clean towels；under the table 修饰 basket。
The sign near the entrance gives opening hours to visitors, and the staff update it whenever the schedule for the building changes.
主干：The sign gives opening hours；near the entrance 修饰 sign。

cards.title: 从句与分词短语
rows: 定语从句
The woman who leads the team checks each report before the meeting and shares the main findings with the other members.
The woman checks each report；who leads the team 修饰 woman。
定语从句
The box that contains the keys stays in the office, where the staff can reach it during their regular working hours.
The box stays in the office；that contains the keys 修饰 box。
定语从句
The road which crosses the bridge connects two villages, and a bus follows this route every morning except on public holidays.
The road connects two villages；which crosses the bridge 修饰 road。
分词短语
The letters sent by the school explain the new schedule, and the parents keep them for reference throughout the coming term.
The letters explain the new schedule；sent by the school 修饰 letters。
分词短语
The people waiting outside the hall received numbered tickets, while the visitors inside listened to a short talk about the exhibition.
The people received numbered tickets；waiting outside the hall 修饰 people。
分词短语
The bench painted by the volunteers stands near the gate, and the children use it while they wait for their bus.
The bench stands near the gate；painted by the volunteers 修饰 bench。

body.box:
The package left near the door contains books for the class.
What contains books?
1. The package
2. The door
3. The class
4. The books

body.p: 主句谓语 contains 的主语是 package。left near the door 修饰 package，第一项正确。

groups.text: The coat by the window belongs to the teacher.

items.why: 主语 coat 与谓语 belongs 构成主干。

groups.text: The notice on the board announces the meeting.

items.why: on the board 紧接并修饰 notice。

groups.text: The farmer who owns the field sells vegetables.

items.why: who owns the field 修饰 farmer，主句谓语是 sells。

groups.text: The dishes washed by the cook are on the shelf.

items.why: washed by the cook 修饰 dishes，说明盘子由厨师清洗。

groups.text: The team that runs the local market prepared a list of sellers for the visitors. The list placed beside the gate includes the names of the sellers and their products.

items.why: 主句主语是 team，that 从句修饰 team。

items.stem: What was placed beside the gate?
items.why: placed beside the gate 修饰 list。

groups.text: The manager of the shop thanked the volunteers who had carried the tables into the room.

items.why: 句子主干是 The manager thanked the volunteers。

groups.text: The flowers growing beside the path attract insects from the nearby garden.

items.why: growing beside the path 修饰 flowers。

groups.text: The map on the wall shows the paths through the park to the visitors who arrive at the information desk.

items.why: 主句的主语是 map，谓语是 shows；on the wall 修饰 map。

groups.text: The box under the counter holds the paper bags that customers use for carrying small items from the store.

options: The items carried from the store
items.why: under the counter 修饰 box。

groups.text: The woman who planned the event gave the visitors a short guide to the rooms in the old building.

items.stem: Who gave the guide to the visitors?
items.why: 主句的主语是 woman，谓语是 gave；who 从句修饰 woman。

groups.text: The clock that hangs above the door reminds the workers of the time when the office closes each evening.

items.why: that hangs above the door 是修饰 clock 的定语从句。

groups.text: The children waiting near the gate watched the buses that passed the school on their way to the station.

items.why: 主句的主语是 children，谓语是 watched；waiting near the gate 修饰 children。

groups.text: The chair repaired by the carpenter stands in the room where the family reads together after dinner.

items.why: repaired by the carpenter 修饰 chair，说明椅子由木匠修理。

groups.text: The list of books recommended by the teacher includes stories about places that the class has discussed.

items.why: 主语是 list，includes 是主句谓语。

groups.text: The guests who arrived before lunch left their coats on the chairs beside the table in the hall.

items.why: who arrived before lunch 修饰 guests。
